parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL1075189 (pyruvate kinase PKM). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to ensure canonical SMILES are present. Sort results by compound ChEMBL ID.
